description: Browse Snapchat's public lens charts by category, look up lenses by URL or UUID, or search the Explore lens tab by keyword.

category.description: (mode=home) Which public Snapchat lens chart to page through. For You, Trending and Face are the deepest charts; World, Music and Live are shorter.
category.title: Lens chart category

includeMoreLenses.description: (mode=detail) Include the related lenses Snapchat shows beside the lens. Up to 12 are returned; the lens itself is excluded when Snapchat includes it.
includeMoreLenses.title: Include related lenses

includeSpotlightsUsingLens.description: (mode=detail) Include Spotlight videos that use this lens, with thumbnails, media URLs, creator details, engagement counts and AI-generated descriptions when public.
includeSpotlightsUsingLens.title: Include related Spotlights

keywords.description: (mode=search) Keywords, brands or creator names to search on the public Snapchat Explore lens tab. Snapchat returns at most 24 lenses per keyword.
keywords.title: Search keywords

lensUrlsOrIds.description: (mode=detail) Lens page URLs (snapchat.com/lens/{uuid}), unlock URLs with a uuid= parameter, or bare 32-character UUIDs.
lensUrlsOrIds.title: Lens URLs or UUIDs

maxItems.description: Global cap on saved records. Home mode pages through the selected chart until this cap or the end of the chart; the other modes stop when their inputs are exhausted.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: Browse the public lens charts, fetch specific lenses, or search the Explore lens tab.
enumTitles: Look up specific lenses by URL or UUID
mode.title: What to scrape

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy override. Snapchat's public lens pages work without a proxy; leave this empty unless you hit rate limiting.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Snapchat Lens Scraper Input
